lines.t: (Verse 1)
Lord,
I want to come to You,
To feel Your love so true,
A love that makes me feel a joy.
A joy so strong,
That never fades.
It never slumbers,
It never goes away.
I want to come to You, Lord.
And be filled with this joy.
A flood of joy that reaches
Into the deepest parts of me,
Into the hidden places that
Only You see.
(Pre-Chorus)
A joy that seeps into the
Innermost parts
Crafted by Your fingertips.
A joy that causes words of praise
To You to forever be on my lips.
(Chorus)
All I want is to feel the joy of You,
Lord.
All I want is to to feel Your love,
Lord.
A love that surpasses time and space,
A love found in every place.
A love cleansing every part,
A love that will never depart.
A place of perfect peace,
Of undefiled love.
Love and joy from above.
(Verse 2)
Lord, I know I was never alone.
That to You I was never unknown.
You are with me and in me,
You are the blood of my veins,
The salt of my tears,
Healing wounds,
Washing away my fears.
(Bridge)
You said,
"Oh My beloved, let Me wipe them away, even every one, numbering them, accounting them unto love’s purpose".
Lord, I'll gladly let You.
Lord, all I want is to feel Your love,
To feel this joy from above.
You are the fulfillment of all things.
The bright light shining on the cloudy day.
In Your arms heaven and earth pass away.
Perfect fulfillment remains.
Me united to You in love,
A perfect love.
A love that brings forth a perfect joy,
A feeling only You can employ.
